topic: Data delivery timeline and calibration plan
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on setting deadlines for data delivery, specifically involving lidar and Wi-Fi sensor data. Concerns were raised regarding the current fluctuation of Wi-Fi data and the required calibration time frame.

**Key Deliverables & Deadlines:**
*   Lidar session-based data is planned for the dashboard by Wednesday (this week).
*   A meeting/check (MC) to validate lidar and calibrate Wi-Fi sensors is needed next week.
*   The model for Wi-Fi data is tentatively scheduled for November 5th, assuming no higher priorities arise.

The team agreed that a preliminary Excel version of the data could be provided this week.
decisions: Lidar dashboard data release set for Wednesday (this week).
A follow-up meeting/check (MC) to validate lidar and calibrate Wi-Fi is scheduled for next week.
The Wi-Fi model development deadline is tentatively set for November 5th.
action_items: Provide preliminary Excel data this week.
Finalize the timeline for sensor calibration and dashboard updates.
